items.change: Typer: member/index access on a union that contains at least one container member skips `null` members (the result gains `| null`) and reports a contradiction only when no member supports the access; `==`/`!=` with both operand types known and kind sets disjoint after integer⊆number folding emits a 'type' issue `'==' can never be true: <left> vs <right>` at the right operand, literal-vs-enum reports `<literal> is not one of [...]`; after a depth issue return UNKNOWN without cascading 'untyped' issues for ancestors. items.title: FlowExpr evaluator safety and budget (regex, dates, literals, value depth, step budget — RFC-0003)
items.change: Regex: the pattern operand of `matches`/`regex_test`/`regex_match` must be a string literal (compile-time `E_EXPR_REGEX_DYNAMIC`, evaluator `INVALID_ARGUMENT` for hand-built ASTs) and is vetted with `recheck` 4.5.0 (`E_EXPR_REGEX_UNSAFE` / `INVALID_REGEX`); pattern ≤ 1 024 chars, subject ≤ 65 536 chars (`INVALID_ARGUMENT`); compiled `RegExp` memoised per Evaluator in a 256-entry LRU; use `re2` when installed in the worker. Dates: `toDate` accepts only epoch milliseconds, `YYYY-MM-DD` (UTC midnight) or RFC 3339 date-time with `Z`/`±HH:MM`; everything else is `INVALID_DATE` naming the accepted forms.
